plan.title: Gender Improvement Comparison
plan.subtitle: Comparing physical performance gains between female and male participants

panels.title: Female Avg Improvement (Sit-ups)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Female' AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Male Avg Improvement (Sit-ups)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Male' AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Female Avg Improvement (Shuttle)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Female' AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Male Avg Improvement (Shuttle)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Male' AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Improvement by Gender and Metric
panels.sql: SELECT 'Sit-ups' AS metric, AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS avg_change FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Female' AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Sit-ups', AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Male' AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Shuttle', AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Female' AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Shuttle', AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Gender" = 'Male' AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Detailed Gender Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT b."Gender", COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS situp_change, AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS shuttle_change FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative:
To determine if girls and boys are improving equally, we analyzed the change in physical metrics between baseline and endline data. The average improvement in sit-ups for female participants is {{p1}}, while male participants showed an average improvement of {{p2}}. This suggests a difference in strength endurance gains between the two groups.

When examining speed via the shuttle run, female participants improved by an average of {{p3}} seconds, whereas male participants improved by {{p4}} seconds. A negative value indicates a reduction in time, which is an improvement in speed.

The bar chart visualizes these disparities across both metrics, highlighting whether one gender is outperforming the other in specific areas. The detailed table provides the exact counts and average changes for each gender, allowing for a granular comparison of progress.
